## Summary
What this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / build / chore

## Checklist
- [ ] `python -m pytest fyp/tests -q` passes
- [ ] A test covers the bug fix or new behaviour
- [ ] Documentation updated (README / docs/) if behaviour, flags or outputs changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under `Unreleased`
- [ ] No videos, caches or files over 100 MB added
- [ ] Feature-shaping flags unchanged, or training CSVs re-extracted and models retrained
